title: The Parolee's Ordnance
logline: An ex-convict trying to run an honest drive-tuning shop is framed when her former crew stashes stolen naval munitions in her shop exhaust flue before an unannounced compliance sweep.

roles.description: Former smuggler on strict conditional release; trying to run an honest drive-tuning shop in the outer ring.
Suspicious habitat compliance officer who believes all repeat offenders eventually slip up.
Slick former accomplice who views rehabilitation as an insult to old loyalty.
A cramped, low-g repair berth with a sputtering plasma torch and stacks of reconditioned manifolds.
A shielded disposal depot in the station's deep keel where dangerous debris is dumped.

public_situation: A paroled starship mechanic on {system} faces an unannounced compliance sweep that could revoke their conditional release and shutter their repair bay.
private_truth: The mechanic's former crew hid a stolen military torpedo casing in the shop's exhaust chimney to hide it from station patrols, leaving the mechanic to face the prison term.

beats.public_change: Compliance drones begin cordoning off outer repair berths for mandatory unannounced safety inspections.

missions.reason: She needs an unmonitored pilot to extract the heavy torpedo casing stashed in her exhaust flue before the compliance drones scan her bay.
missions.private_fact: She cannot report the ordnance without her parole being instantly revoked for possessing restricted military components.

beats.public_change: The probation inspector arrives at the workshop perimeter with chemical sniffers and a squad of port bailiffs.

missions.reason: He hires an outsider pilot to run an independent ion residue scan on the shop's outer vents to settle an equipment dispute.
missions.private_fact: He received an anonymous tip about the torpedo from the old crew, who want the machinist jailed before she talks.

beats.public_change: The old crew's fixer surfaces near the containment docks, waiting to reclaim the stolen ordnance or ensure the machinist takes the blame.

missions.reason: She begs the pilot to dump the torpedo into the deep keel containment vault before either the inspector or her old crew can trace it to her.
missions.private_fact: If she dumps the torpedo, she loses all evidence that her former crew planted it to frame her.

player_choice.prompt: With the ordnance secured in cargo, the pilot can either dump it, turn it over to the inspector with proof of the frame-up, or return it to the fixer for a payout.

options.label: Deliver the torpedo and fixer's com-logs to the inspector
Sell the stolen torpedo back to the old crew's fixer
Jettison the torpedo into the scrap containment vault

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot turns over the ordnance and communication logs proving the frame-up.
resolutions.summary: {role:probation_inspector} arrests {role:old_crew_fixer} for the planting operation. {role:paroled_machinist} keeps her shop and her conditional freedom.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot caught an old crime crew framing their reformed mechanic with stolen military warheads.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot dumps the torpedo into the scrap containment vault, leaving no physical evidence.
resolutions.summary: The compliance sweep finds nothing. {role:paroled_machinist} avoids prison but remains under intense surveillance, while her old crew walks free.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot quietly disposed of unregistered naval munitions down a habitat's deep keel.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the torpedo back to the fixer.
resolutions.summary: {role:old_crew_fixer} pays off the pilot and smuggles the torpedo off-station. {role:paroled_machinist} is left terrified that her former crew will return.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot traded stolen naval munitions back to an outer-ring syndicate for private coin.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the task.
resolutions.summary: The compliance inspection discovers the torpedo casing in the exhaust flue. {role:paroled_machinist} is sent back to the penal colony while the shop is seized.

loose_threads.detail: The torpedo casing carries an impound seal from a commercial salvage firm operating in the outer ring.
The inspector's transfer application to the central administrative ring was approved the morning before the raid was ordered.

radio_hooks: Habitat compliance sweeps intensify across outer maintenance rings of {system}.
Independent mechanics protest unannounced shop inspections by port bailiffs.
Unregistered munitions rumors denied by station probation board.

voice_direction.paroled_machinist: Speaks in hurried, breathy sentences and constantly corrects her own phrasing to sound cooperative. Avoids using slang from prison.
voice_direction.probation_inspector: Flat, methodical, and asks rhetorical questions without waiting for answers. Never raises his voice.
voice_direction.old_crew_fixer: Overly familiar and relaxed, speaking in low murmurs. Treats legal trouble like a practical joke between friends.
